recommendation.summary: S6 transactional patch set of 1 function(s) (body-only change).
justification: no state-schema, dependency, toolchain, goroutine-structure or long-running-code change
every member of the patch set is an ordinary non-generic function or method, so each can be redirected through its slot, and the whole set is published in one atomic PatchSet store
alternatives: S2 Go plugin swap of the affected handler (same toolchain; old code leaks)
S1 epoch swap if v2 is compiled in alongside v1 (pre-staged release)
S5 FD-passing handoff (identity state transfer) or rolling update as fallback
risks: changed functions are small enough to be inlined; with S6 slot trampolines the call still dispatches through the slot, but raw binary patching (internal/livepatch) must also patch the inlining callers: github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.ApplicationAPI.DeleteApplication, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.ApplicationAPI.UpdateApplication, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.ApplicationAPI.UploadApplicationImage, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.ClientAPI.DeleteClient, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.ClientAPI.UpdateClient, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.MessageAPI.DeleteMessage, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.MessageAPI.DeleteMessageWithApplication, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.MessageAPI.GetMessagesWithApplication, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.PluginAPI.DisablePlugin, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.PluginAPI.EnablePlugin, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.PluginAPI.GetConfig, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.PluginAPI.GetDisplay, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.PluginAPI.UpdateConfig, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.UserAPI.DeleteUserByID, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.UserAPI.GetUserByID, github.com/gotify/server/v2/api.UserAPI.UpdateUserByID
